Sixteenth TU reconstruction pilot: ov002/daObj1UpLogo_c. include/daObj1UpLogo_c.h already declared real inheritance (struct daObj1UpLogo_c : dActor_c) going in, so no header rewrite was needed. tubuild create produced a shadow TU with the same SharedFilePtr shadow-vs-real collision as the daObjNumber_c pilot (#1733): SharedFilePtr.h's real class deliberately has no fields, but this TU needs both .file field access (InitResources) and .Release() method calls (CleanupResources) on the same two extern globals. Fixed with the same pattern: a local SharedFilePtrLayout{int a, file;} struct backs the externs, LoadFile call sites cast through *(SharedFilePtr*)&x to satisfy the SharedFilePtr& parameter, and Release() call sites cast through ((SharedFilePtr*)&x)->Release() to reach the real class's own method. The legacy D0.cpp/D1.cpp were already plain out-of-line daObj1UpLogo_c::~daObj1UpLogo_c(){} redefinitions (no ICE), so the destructor pair needed no fix. daObj1UpLogo_c_classInit needed the standard +2 vtable addend fix. 8/8 MATCH, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean -> TEXT-VERIFIED. linkcheck --partial: 8/8 contribution-equivalent, module 106/106, ROM builds -> PARTIAL-LINK-VERIFIED, predicted correctly in advance by the D0/Spawn grep (both already referenced the project's own _ZTV14daObj1UpLogo_c).
